_comment: SS11 item 13: mountain vs highway, focused specifically on the interaction-load hypothesis (SS5.2.2 'normalized_context_hypothesis'): high-interaction quiz/ranking_creation are -1.0 on mountain, while low-interaction music_playlist/radio_style are +0.5 on mountain (and both groups are non-negative on highway) - every other field is absent (neutral), isolating road_type as the sole driver.
expected_direction: at highway, quiz and ranking_creation (each +1.0) rank strictly above music_playlist and radio_style (each 0.0); at mountain, quiz and ranking_creation go NEGATIVE (-1.0) while music_playlist and radio_style go positive (+0.5) - both high-interaction candidates drop below both low-interaction candidates.
